sources.note: public GCS bucket gs://flywire_v141_m783/skeletons_mip_1, read by HTTP range requests

sources.what: cell types, soma positions, fru/dsx + dimorphism annotations

provenance.circuit: cVA: ORN_DA1 -> DA1_lPN/vPN -> lateral-horn relay -> pC1a-e / vpoEN / oviIN / mAL -> vpoDN and other descending neurons

selection.orn: cell_type ORN_DA1, evenly sampled by root_id
selection.lhn: second-order targets of the DA1 projection neurons: neurons receiving >=10 synapses from DA1_lPN/DA1_vPN, excluding the PNs themselves, the dimorphic core, Kenyon cells (KC*) and antennal-lobe local neurons (*LN*), ranked by (synapses from DA1 PNs) x (1 + synapses onto the dimorphic core); top 60. The documented fru+ aSP-f / aSP-g / aSP10 lateral-horn classes are then added (up to 25) whether or not they score.
selection.dimorphic: pC1a-e, vpoEN, oviIN/oviDN and the fru+ mAL interneurons (<=130)
selection.descending: vpoDN plus the top 30 descending targets of the dimorphic core
selection.other: super_class central / optic / visual_projection with >=500 incoming synapses, spatially stratified for silhouette

provenance.transform: FAFB nanometre coords -> recentred, uniform scale into the SPEC box, y negated so dorsal is +y
provenance.morphologyNote: polylines are arc-length resamplings of published skeletons; no coordinate is synthesised
provenance.somaNote: sensory and ascending neurons have no soma inside FAFB (the ORN somata sit in the antenna), so for those the release's pos_x/pos_y/pos_z point on the neuron is used
provenance.dimorphicFlag: stage == dimorphic, or the release's own fru_dsx / dimorphism annotation
